title: Voice chat card: the Voice dialog (speed and voice) and the Language picker

evidence: 1.2.3 (decision 0010). app/src/components/overlays/VoiceDialog.tsx: the Voice row is one button reading "<voice> <speed>" ("Helix 1.0x") that opens a dialog 4 pt above it, right edges aligned: the Speed slider (0.5x to 2x, read from the thumb at 1.0x) over a grid of 28 voices, two to a row, scrolling inside 268 pt and opening with the picked voice in its middle. Pickers.tsx: Language, a list of 29. A pick changes its row (Shell holds the card's values; behaviour: scripts/lib/picker-pick.mjs). Keys (scripts/lib/overlay-keys.mjs): Language opens on its picked option, focused and highlighted; arrows move focus and data-highlighted; Escape closes without choosing and returns focus. Missing: Altair, Ara, Atlas and Aurora (named from 0.79.3; their row sits above the window in 1.2.3's capture) have no line, as none was captured; preview buttons play nothing (no voice source).
